text_block_list.text:
It's time for summer camp, and the sun is

unrelenting. This year looks to be the
hottest on
record.
Huff... Puff... Damn... What's up with this heat?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Be sure to drink plenty of water.

text_block_list.text: ...I know... Pant.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Are you sure, President Rudolf?!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I heard you guys were having a hard
time
making progress. I would offer my
support, if you
would have it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Yippeee! I'm so happy! We're gonna
learn so
much from you!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: But what about your own training?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Not to worry. It's helpful for me to see
others run
as well.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Not only that, but I have something of a
secret
plan.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Tch! Even after changing clothes, I still
feel
gross...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Oh, Brian. Here you are.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...Rudolf? If it's paperwork you've got, I
don't
want it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Haha. Cutting straight to the chase, I
see. Don't
worry. I did not bring you to
the student council
to tie you to a desk.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I expect you to show me a future I'm
incapable of
creating myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Let me cut to the chase as
well. Do
you have time to run a
scrimmage with me
tomorrow?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Ha... Not at all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'd be happy to accept. It's okay, right?
Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Haha! There's no way I'd let this
opportunity pass
me by! I'm goi—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Nothing. I'm going to get started on
my
afternoon training.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can you handle the details for
me? Just
tell me what you end up
deciding.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Heh... I see she's as self-centered as
ever. You
seem to be getting pushed
around quite a bit.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I suppose you're right.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And so, after arranging the details of the

scrimmage with Симболи Рудольф, I rush
over to
Нарита Брайан.
Ughhh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is lying passed out on the
beach.
Nnngh... Where...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Trainer! She's regained consciousness!
text_block_list.name: Medical Staff

text_block_list.text:
You're not well... You're suffering from
summer
heat fatigue and mild heat
stroke.
text_block_list.name: Medical Staff

text_block_list.text:
Please avoid any strenuous activity for
the time
being. It would be dangerous to
overexert
yourself in this condition.
text_block_list.name: Medical Staff

text_block_list.text: But, I have a scrimmage tomorrow!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You want to call it off because of
something so
minor?! You're
underestimating me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Be that as it may, I'm worried about your health.

text_block_list.text: You've got to be joking!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You're worrying too much! Don't take
this away
from me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I'm telling you this because I don't want to take it away!

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
A race between Umamusume is the
epitome of
extreme speed. Such
exertion puts an immense
amount of
strain on their legs.

Moreover, Нарита Брайан is the type of
runner who
will run as hard as she can,
regardless of the
circumstances. If she
were to collapse in her
current state...
choice_data_list: As your trainer, this is non-negotiable.

text_block_list.text: ...Tch! With this kind of trainer—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I hurry to support her as she crumples to
her
knees.
Her body lacks any strength whatsoever.
Just stop, okay? I get it already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for losing it like that. I didn't
mean to
worry you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Heat stroke?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I understand completely. Brian, don't
worry about
the scrimmage, or anything
else for that matter. I
will find someone
else.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Don't work yourself up over this. Just
get some
rest. Now, if you'll excuse me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Don't apologize.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: It was my fault. I did it to myself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: The next day...

Do your best, Oguri!
You're amazing,
President!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text: Clang!

The back-and-forth between the two
racers is
breathtaking. Even if it's just a
scrimmage, the
race between two
first-class runners captures
everyone's
attention.
Нарита Брайан, on the other hand...

So I just get to watch through the
window, huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What a rip-off...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Don't... I don't need your sympathy.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It's my own carelessness that got me
here. It's
totally on me for blowing the
chance I'd been
waiting for.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We've got to rebuild me from the
foundation up
to prevent this from ever
happening again.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Just to be safe, she gets a
comprehensive
physical later. The tests
reveal no abnormalities.

It's so ridiculous being defeated by the
heat. Do I
not have enough guts or
something?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...It sucks not being able to run!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
After that, Нарита Брайан doesn't take her
eyes off
the race.

Just to be safe, she gets a
comprehensive
physical later. The tests
reveal no abnormalities.

She resumes training the next day with a
whole
new regimen, vowing never to
make the same
mistake again.

But her eyes reflect a summer of
lingering regret
and frustration.
